native_route_assessments.economic_transfer: Long/short contract holders pay or receive funding; broker and financing counterparties allocate carry, not guaranteed excess return
native_route_assessments.pre_decision_variable: Historical as-of swap/financing schedule, current contract position-size lattice and contemporaneous executable bid/ask
native_route_assessments.delayed_reflection: No verified delayed repricing mechanism: predictable accrual is ordinarily anticipated
native_route_assessments.falsification: Identical-entry cash and matched forward/basis baseline with funding paid/received, dated fees, true rollover, and hedged risk
native_route_assessments.overlap: Prior cash-futures basis/catchup and matched-base exacts; isolated present-day swap schedule is not novel return information

native_route_assessments.economic_transfer: Quoting liquidity suppliers revise bid/ask after reference markets move; a trader would cross spread and assume adverse-selection risk
native_route_assessments.pre_decision_variable: Receipt-ordered top-of-book bid/ask revision times on two genuinely matched Pepperstone products
native_route_assessments.delayed_reflection: Finite quote refresh and contract-specific mapping lag; not proof accessible profit once quotes mature
native_route_assessments.falsification: Same timestamps and signed price-reference baseline including quote-side catch-up, FX lead-lag, full bid/ask costs and latency
native_route_assessments.overlap: Already covered by quote-side catchup, five-second impulse, FX cross-pair lead/lag and native update asymmetry

native_route_assessments.economic_transfer: Market makers widen or tighten two-sided quotes in response to risk; trader pays liquidity premium
native_route_assessments.pre_decision_variable: Broker spreads and timestamps of causally synchronized different asset classes
native_route_assessments.delayed_reflection: Common liquidity shocks can propagate between desks but spread forecast does not establish sign of future return
native_route_assessments.falsification: Identical-event own-spread persistence and prior frozen six-feature liquidity forecaster
native_route_assessments.overlap: Broker liquidity forecast and previously frozen cross-asset liquidity model target future friction

native_route_assessments.economic_transfer: Hedgers and producers transfer inventory/exposure across maturities; CFD holder pays contract-specific roll/financing
native_route_assessments.pre_decision_variable: Exact matched underlying, expiry, settlement, first-visible roll revisions, executable forward/cash quotes
native_route_assessments.delayed_reflection: Potential constrained roll liquidity, but no dated causal roll state or distinct repricing documented
native_route_assessments.falsification: Same-underlying basis/catch-up exact and hedge-at-minimum-ticket after spread/funding/roll conversion
native_route_assessments.overlap: Cash-futures basis reversion and same-underlying futures-led cash catch-up are previously closed exact scopes

native_route_assessments.economic_transfer: Systematic hedgers rebalance exposures across related assets; informed side is not observed in broker quote volume
native_route_assessments.pre_decision_variable: Completed, receipt-aligned broker instrument price changes, tick counts and group membership
native_route_assessments.delayed_reflection: Hedger adjustment could be staggered but remains a hypothesis about existing price-only information
native_route_assessments.falsification: Matched same-hour own-body baseline, historical peer breadth, cross-sectional ranking and directional lead-lag controls
native_route_assessments.overlap: Prior synchronized breadth, cross-sectional momentum, regime and lead-lag research

native_route_assessments.economic_transfer: Liquidity providers adjust inventory and spreads at opens, halts and closures; investors pay wider entry costs
native_route_assessments.pre_decision_variable: As-of historical market schedule revisions, session-specific spread and broker status
native_route_assessments.delayed_reflection: A calendar time or known session is not a new surprise; pre-entry liquidity shocks need dated observed cause
native_route_assessments.falsification: Session transition/gap exacts and same-entry dynamic-exit/friction baseline
native_route_assessments.overlap: XPT session transition gap, US opening gaps, liquidity transitions and session-time research

native_route_assessments.economic_transfer: Stock issuer distributes cash; broker CFD applies price/cash adjustment; financing and short adjustment may offset
native_route_assessments.pre_decision_variable: As-of issuer corporate-action schedule plus exact broker dated CFD cash/price adjustment and trade conditions
native_route_assessments.delayed_reflection: No verified delayed assimilation after broker adjustment; mechanical ex-dividend price gap is not alpha
native_route_assessments.falsification: Cash-equivalent total-return accounting and matched single-name/cross-sectional baselines including adjustment and spread
native_route_assessments.overlap: Prior stock opening-gap/momentum/mean-reversion research; broker dividend adjustments alone do not create distinct uncompensated profit

rejection_basis: None of the seven native routes has both a distinct authentic before-entry information source and a demonstrated delayed economic transfer plus complete matched-cost prospective setup; overlapping old price/quote transformations are not relabeled as novelty
cost_first_gate: At min native ticket require true bid/ask, side commissions, FX conversion, slip, financing, margin <=80 EUR, stressed aggregate loss <=2 EUR, and reserve >=120 EUR. Absent observed fees/quotes cannot be treated as zeros.
